_comment: Image sets Claude picks from. {builtin} is the dynamic wallpaper extension's included_image_sets folder. Folders in ~/.local/share/daily-wallpaper/sets/ are picked up too (description from description.txt).

sets.name: aurora
sets.description: Flat illustration: pine trees on a ridge above layered misty mountain valleys, birds in the sky; pink dawn, pale blue day, orange dusk, northern lights at night. Calm, Nordic, cool.

sets.name: beach
sets.description: Flat illustration of a rocky cove with a sandy beach, turquoise water and red flowers; bright summery noon, purple evening. Mediterranean, warm, holiday mood.

sets.name: bitday
sets.description: Pixel art: green meadow at the sea, big sun and small clouds, red sunset, crescent moon and stars at night. Minimal, playful, retro game look.

sets.name: cliffs
sets.description: Big Sur style coastal road winding along steep cliffs above the ocean, low-poly illustration in purples and warm sandstone. Road trip, dramatic, colourful.

sets.name: desert
sets.description: Low-poly desert valley with dunes, rocks, agaves and distant mountains; sandy orange by day, violet at dusk and night. Dry, warm, spacious.

sets.name: earth
sets.description: Photo of planet Earth from space on black; fully lit at noon, crescent at dawn and dusk, a thin rim at night. Very dark, minimal, cosmic.

sets.name: gradient
sets.description: Plain colour gradients with no motif: teal morning, yellow-orange noon, purple-pink evening, navy night. Most minimal and least distracting.

sets.name: island
sets.description: Painted fantasy island with jungle, wooden huts and a lighthouse on calm sea, fluffy clouds. Adventurous, cosy, Ghibli-like.

sets.name: lake
sets.description: Low-poly mountain gorge with a lake, pine forest and a leaning tree; turquoise water by day, vivid violet at dusk and night. Fresh, outdoorsy.

sets.name: lakeside
sets.description: Flat illustration of a deer by a small lake in a fir forest clearing with mountains; pink dawn, blue day with a glowing sun, starry night. Quiet, wintry, peaceful.

sets.name: mountains
sets.description: Firewatch-style layered forest and mountain ridges, golden-green sunrise and sunset, misty blue day, very dark starry night. Hiking, autumnal, atmospheric.

sets.name: sahara
sets.description: Minimal dunes under a big sky: deep blue dawn, coral-pink day with a pale sun, purple night with a crescent moon. Warm, soft, dreamy.
